title: Powerball Odds Worsened To 1 In 292 Million
hook: Powerball changed its rules and made winning even harder.
closing: Bigger jackpots came with worse odds for every ticket.
question: Do worse odds change whether you play?

segments.say: Powerball's one-in-292-million chance makes a lifetime lightning strike look ordinary.
Even a lifetime shark attack at one in 11.5 million is far likelier.
The rule change worsened jackpot odds to one in 292 million per play.
